items.title: Adaptive Retrieval helps Reasoning in LLMs -- but mostly if it's not used
items.title_zh: 自适应检索有助于大模型推理——但主要是在不使用检索时
items.summary: The authors compare an LLM agent that decides when to query an external knowledge base against chain-of-thought and static retrieval on GSM8K and MATH-500. Static retrieval underperformed CoT, and traces without retrieval actually did better than CoT, suggesting retrieval only rarely helps reasoning and that choosing not to retrieve is a useful metacognitive signal; retrieval frequency scaled with problem difficulty.

items.title: InftyThink+: Effective and Efficient Infinite-Horizon Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: InftyThink+：通过强化学习实现高效无限视野推理
items.summary: InftyThink+ is an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework that trains a model to choose when to summarize intermediate thoughts, what to preserve and how to resume reasoning, using a supervised cold-start followed by trajectory-level RL. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B it improves AIME24 accuracy by 21%, outperforms conventional long chain-of-thought RL by a clear margin and reduces inference latency.

items.title: PlugMem: A Task-Agnostic Plugin Memory Module for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: PlugMem：面向 LLM 智能体的任务无关插件式记忆模块
items.summary: PlugMem is a task-agnostic plug-in memory module that structures episodic memories into a compact, extensible knowledge-centric memory graph of propositional and prescriptive knowledge, making knowledge rather than entities or text chunks the unit of memory access. Across conversational QA, multi-hop retrieval and web-agent benchmarks it beats task-agnostic baselines and task-specific memory designs while achieving the highest information density, with code released.

items.title: Massive Sound Embedding Benchmark (MSEB)
items.summary: MSEB is an extensible benchmark for evaluating the auditory components of multimodal systems, covering eight core tasks such as transcription, classification, retrieval, reasoning, segmentation, clustering, reranking and reconstruction, plus the new Simple Voice Questions dataset. Its initial experiments show clear performance headroom.

items.title: ACAR: Adaptive Complexity Routing for Multi-Model Ensembles with Auditable Decision Traces
items.title_zh: ACAR：面向多模型集成的自适应复杂度路由与可审计决策追踪
items.summary: ACAR routes tasks among one-, two- and three-model execution modes using self-consistency variance from three probe samples, evaluated on 1,510 tasks and more than 7,550 auditable runs with Claude Sonnet 4, GPT-4o and Gemini 2.0 Flash. Sigma-based routing reached 55.6% accuracy versus a 54.4% two-model baseline while avoiding full ensembling on 54.2% of tasks, and retrieval augmentation reduced accuracy by 3.4 percentage points because median retrieval similarity was only 0.167.

items.title: PACIFIC: Can LLMs Discern the Psychometric Traits Influencing Your Preferences? Personality-Driven Preference Alignment in LLMs
items.title_zh: PACIFIC：基于人格特质的 LLM 偏好对齐
items.summary: PACIFIC uses Big-Five personality traits as a latent signal for organizing and reasoning over user preference histories, evaluated on a 1,200-pair psychometric dataset spanning travel, movies and education. With clean trait-aligned context LLMs reached up to 99% accuracy, while a persona-aware contrastive retriever (PiRAG) raised label-free accuracy from 30% to 43%, identifying retrieval as the bottleneck.

items.title: Multi-Agentic AI for Fairness-Aware and Accelerated Multi-modal Large Model Inference in Real-world Mobile Edge Networks
items.title_zh: 面向移动边缘网络多模态大模型推理的多智能体公平加速框架
items.summary: The paper proposes a multi-agent framework with a long-term global planning agent, a short-term prompt scheduling agent and on-node deployment agents that reason in natural language over runtime telemetry to route prompts and place multimodal models in mobile edge networks. On a city-wide testbed it reduces average end-to-end latency by 42.9% versus an online-learning baseline and 80.6% versus full activation, maintaining a mean service-type Jain's index of 0.925.

items.title: google-gemini/gemini-skills
items.title_zh: google-gemini/gemini-skills：面向 Gemini API 与 Agent 的技能集
items.summary: A Python repository that provides skills for the Gemini API, SDK and model or agent interactions.

items.title: op7418/CodePilot
items.title_zh: op7418/CodePilot：多模型 AI Agent 桌面客户端
items.summary: CodePilot is a multi-model AI agent desktop client built with Electron and Next.js that can connect to any AI provider, be extended with MCP and skills, and be controlled from a phone.
